title: Neil Armstrong's 1975 Tayos cave expedition
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Neil Armstrong's 1975 Tayos cave expedition, about 1975 at Tayos cave, Ecuador, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In 1975, he brought a BBC film crew to explore what he thought was, you know, maybe an alien cave at the edge of the Amazon in Ecuador.

Neil Armstrong when he came back
from the moon in 1976, he does this
other mission at the edge of the Amazon.
tellings.difference: Dates it to 1976 instead of 1975 and leaves out the BBC film crew.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Neil Armstrong's expedition to the Tayos cave at the edge of the Amazon in Ecuador.

as_told.title: Neil Armstrong's expedition to the Tayos cave
